description: Make the episode: 3-8 shots, 12-60 seconds, the same fictional character in every shot, narrated with captions. CHARGES credits (up to 313 credits for a default 12-second episode; longer ones (up to 60 seconds) cost more). ALWAYS call quote_character_episode first and tell the human the price: the human, not the agent, decides to spend. This tool refuses unless confirm is true, expectedCredits equals the price computed now (a changed price answers 409 PRICE_CHANGED and charges nothing) and idempotencyKey is set; StoryShort has no daily spending cap per key, so these are the guard. The series must have a REVIEWED, CONFIRMED season plan and the episode must be one of its episodes exactly as planned (SEASON_PLAN_REQUIRED / SEASON_NOT_REVIEWED / EPISODE_NOT_IN_PLAN otherwise, with a nextAction, nothing charged); the narrator voice, language, style, look and outfit come from the plan. Credits are held when it starts. A shot that cannot be animated keeps a still image and its clip credits go back; if too few shots move, or anything else fails, everything goes back. Characters are fictional adults (or animals / mascots), AI-generated: no real or famous people, no children or anyone who looks under 18, no sexual content, no logos or protected characters (refused with CONTENT_POLICY, nothing charged). Everything made here is AI-generated and labelled as such. Takes about 10-25 minutes: poll get_video with arguments { id: <the returned id / videoId> }; it reports status, stage and, when COMPLETED, videoUrl. One episode at a time per account. Requires the "video:create" scope.

confirm.description: Must be true: making an episode spends credits, and the human has seen the price.

expectedCredits.description: The credits the quote showed the human. Must match the price computed now.

idempotencyKey.description: Required. One new unique key per purchase; a repeat with the same key returns the first answer (replayed: true) and charges nothing.

language.description: Omit it: the narration language is the season plan's. If given it must equal the plan's.

script.description: The narration, about 29-147 words. The system splits it into shots by sentence. Give `script` OR `shots`, exactly as planned (get_season_plan).

seriesId.description: A series id from list_series whose season plan is reviewed and confirmed.

sheetId.description: Omit it: the character sheet is the one the season plan names for this episode. If given it must equal that sheet.

shotCount.description: With `script`: how many shots to split it into. Omit for an automatic count.

shots.description: The shots of the planned episode. Give `shots` OR `script`.

action.description: What the viewer sees the character doing. Omit to illustrate the narration.

camera.description: Camera: wide shot, close-up, push-in, over-the-shoulder... Omit for an automatic choice.

narration.description: What the narrator says over this shot.
